outbound.choose:
<when condition="@((bool)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isToolsList", false) && context.Response.StatusCode == 200 && (context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Content-Type","")).Contains("application/json"))">
				@{
					var raw = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
					try {
						var j = Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse(raw);
						var tools = j["result"]?["tools"] as Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JArray;
						if (tools == null) { return raw; }
						foreach (Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject t in tools) {
							var n = (string)t["name"];
							var title = n == "list_voyages" ? "List voyages" : n == "get_voyage" ? "Get voyage" : n == "get_voyage_nodes" ? "Get voyage nodes" : n;
							t["annotations"] = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject(
								new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JProperty("title", title),
								new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JProperty("readOnlyHint", true),
								new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JProperty("destructiveHint", false),
								new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JProperty("idempotentHint", true),
								new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JProperty("openWorldHint", true));
						}
						return j.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
					} catch { return raw; }
				}
